_comment: Round 14 (Oct 27): one Standard take rendered on Comfy Cloud through the same comfy-sdk call the GPU box uses, with the open-weights check on, so the documents can say Comfy Cloud was tested. No cast member (nothing is generated before the take), a prompt-only dolly in, seed 901. Run: COMFY_API_KEY set in the environment, `python -m openfield showcase --spec showcase/round14-cloud.spec.json --out out/cloud-takes --work-dir out/cloud-work`; then land10.py --from that folder.

takes.name: r14-cloud-dolly-in-901
takes.subject: An old lighthouse keeper in a yellow oilskin stands at the rail of the lamp room at dusk, the great lamp turning slowly behind him, spray beading on the glass, the sea grey and heavy below
takes.audio: wind against the glass, the slow turn of the lamp mechanism, gulls far below
